name: claude-code-mods
description: Claude Code mods: a living aquarium (reef), a flight recorder (blackbox), a session dashboard (cockpit) and a capability test bench (mods-lab).

plugins.name: reef
plugins.description: A living ASCII aquarium beside the chat: tool calls feed the fish, new fish hatch as Claude works, and the reef sleeps when the session goes quiet.

plugins.name: blackbox
plugins.description: Flight recorder: live radar of tool calls, a diff reel, guard rails for risky commands, and an AI debrief.

plugins.name: cockpit
plugins.description: Session dashboard pane, above-prompt band and status line for context, cost, tools and files.

plugins.name: mods-lab
plugins.description: Capability test bench that calls each mods API from a button and records pass or fail.
